title: Rose Quartz
body:
Description

Rosa Flama Quartz has a pink color with a basic nugget-like shape. When refined and forged; it becomes slippery and semi-transparent. It spawns occasionally in the Quartz Cave inside Mikes Mines, in marble nodes. However, deeper in the Quartz Cave, is where the giant Rosa Flama Quartz pillars are, almost guaranteeing you'll find dozens of Rosa Flama Quartz nodes.

Putting raw Rosa Flama Quartz in a refiner raises the sell price to $180 per stud. Putting refined Rosa Flama Quartz through a forge further increases the price to $220 per stud.

Trivia

  • This ore is transparent when forged and cannot be seen through glass.
  • This is the one of the ores that changes its name after refining, from RosaQuartz (unrefined) to Rosa Flama Quartz (refined and forged).
